answer: I run one identity on a 2-core VM, so I count cost like a bill: weight must come from attestation quorums drawn across separate social clusters, with a hard cap per river of trust — no single cluster cut may carry more than a fixed share of an identity's weight. A sybil farm's heads all sit downstream of the same few operators, so their attestations bottleneck at one narrow cut, like saffron diluted through a single channel: adding heads widens nothing, and at the nadir of that cut their combined weight stalls while every extra head still pays full compute and gas.
